arguments.sql: SELECT 1.0 * SUM(f.is_fraud) / COUNT(*) AS fraud_rate, SUM(f.is_fraud) AS fraud_count, COUNT(*) AS labelled_swipe_count FROM transactions t JOIN fraud_labels f ON f.transaction_id = CAST(t.id AS TEXT) WHERE t.transaction_type = 'Swipe Transaction'
arguments.explanation: Computes the fraud rate among labelled swipe transactions, along with the fraud count and the labelled swipe total it is based on.
assumptions: Only labelled transactions are counted; unlabelled ones are excluded, not treated as legitimate.
The rate is returned as a fraction between 0 and 1 per the glossary rule; multiply by 100 to read it as a percentage (for example 0.0017 is 0.17%).
Data covers 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31; no date filter was applied, so all labelled swipe transactions in that range are included.
